rules: Raw package CHOCH, close_break=True; 3-left/3-right confirmed swings; synthetic endpoints excluded. Formation starts at the reversal extreme between touch and break and ends at package BrokenIndex close; the raw package origin swing is preserved separately. Original anchor AND activation must be within formation. First touch per HTF level in this query, followed by each matching package CHOCH. First later OHLC retest at open-inside or near zone edge; no same-confirmation-bar entry. IFVG and breaker are explicit close-through derivatives, not native package outputs. Excursions exclude entry candle (intrabar order unknown); measured through selected end, without stops/targets/costs.
